arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Test various timezone formats and their normalization
test_cases = [
    ('+0100', '+01:00'),      # Standard format without colon
    ('+01:00', '+01:00'),     # Format with colon
    ('-0500', '-05:00'),      # Negative offset without colon
    ('-05:00', '-05:00'),     # Negative offset with colon
    ('+0000', '+00:00'),      # Zero offset
    ('+1200', '+12:00'),      # Large positive offset
    ('-1200', '-12:00'),      # Large negative offset
    ('+0130', '+01:30'),      # Half hour offset
    ('-0930', '-09:30'),      # Negative half hour offset
]

for input_tz, expected_name in test_cases:
    s = f'1997-07-16T19:20{input_tz}'
    result = parse.parse('{:ti}', s)
    if result is None:
        print(f'FAIL: {input_tz} did not parse')
        continue
    
    tz_info = result.fixed[0].tzinfo
    if tz_info._name != expected_name:
        print(f'FAIL: {input_tz} -> name={tz_info._name!r}, expected {expected_name!r}')
    else:
        print(f'OK: {input_tz} -> name={tz_info._name!r}')

print()
print('Testing equality of equivalent timezones:')
tz1 = parse.parse('{:ti}', '1997-07-16T19:20+0100').fixed[0].tzinfo
tz2 = parse.parse('{:ti}', '1997-07-16T19:20+01:00').fixed[0].tzinfo
print(f'+0100 == +01:00: {tz1 == tz2}')
"
